sloka: इदम् धनुर् वरम् ब्रह्मन् जनकैः अभिपूजितम् ।राजभिः च महा वीर्यैः अशक्तैः पूरितम् तदा ॥१-६७-८॥
transliteration: idam dhanur varam brahman janakaiḥ abhipūjitam ।rājabhiḥ ca mahā vīryaiḥ aśaktaiḥ pūritam tadā ॥1-67-8॥

translations.english: "O Brahman in the olden days, this great bow was worshipped by my forefathers. Powerful kings failed to string this bow.
